title: Book as a guest and pay by card (Stripe test mode)
caption: `tools/e2e/specs/storefront/checkout-stripe.e2e.ts` (nightly `storefront-stripe` project). Needs Stripe test keys and `tools/dev/stripe-listen.sh`; only Stripe's documented test cards.

steps.title: Checkout data
steps.body: Search, price, Continue to checkout; fill travellers, contact, optionally one extra bag; on Payment pick **Card**, tick the terms.
steps.expect: `/checkout/pay-card.html?id=chk_…&payment=pay_…` ("Pay by card"). DB: `payments` `provider = 'stripe'`, `status = 'requires_payment_method'`, `checkouts.status = 'payment_pending'`; Stripe dashboard shows a PaymentIntent with manual capture.

steps.title: Card and review
steps.body: In the Payment Element type `4000 0027 6000 3184`, an expiry three years ahead, CVC `123`, country Spain; press **Review total**.
steps.expect: Final total including the card fee, the merchant name and the statement descriptor. The page itself has no `<input>`: the card is in Stripe's iframe.

steps.title: Pay and 3-D Secure
steps.body: Press **Pay**, then **Complete** in Stripe's test challenge.
steps.expect: `/checkout/complete.html` ("Completing your booking") without `payment_intent_client_secret` in the address, then `/confirmation.html?booking=bkg_…` with the reference.

steps.title: Check the money
steps.body: `SELECT status, amount, amount_captured, card_fee_amount FROM tenant_demo.payments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1;`
steps.expect: `captured` with `amount_captured = amount` once the order exists (capture happens after Flight Create Orders). A sold-out at completion (stub `sold-out`) must leave the PaymentIntent `canceled` and say nothing was charged.

steps.title: E-mail and guest access
steps.body: Open the confirmation e-mail; open its booking link in the same browser.
steps.expect: Subject "Your booking <reference> with Demo Travel is confirmed" with the itinerary; the link opens `/booking.html?id=bkg_…` thanks to `__Host-vx_bt`. In another browser it says "Find your booking".
